name: Silver Lake Campground (Withlacoochee State Forest)
evidence: FFS ReserveAmerica per-site GIS: only sites 13/15/16 'Type of View: Lake', rest Woods; satellite 28.5769,-82.2174: those pads ~45-55 m from Silver Lake behind a continuous hardwood band (no open apron); booking 'on the shore' prose not counting; AWH firsthand partial view -> lakeview

name: Okaloacoochee Slough State Forest - Panther Pond Primitive Campground
evidence: FFS ReserveAmerica site 016 (RV or Tent, 50-ft back-in pad, View: Lake) GIS 26.552897,-81.297657 = turnaround of spur road on Panther Pond's N bank; satellite 26.5527,-81.2974: open grass apron ~20-25 m to open pond water; sites 001-015 tent-type in woods

name: Sunny Shores MH & RV Resort
evidence: satellite 28.7882,-82.1285 (pin = site schema 28.7879,-82.1277, NW 21 Ln): the 'canal' is a narrow duckweed-choked dead-end ditch; RV rows ~30-50 m S of its end behind park road + buildings, W lot behind treeline - no pad on the water; canal/dock prose not counting

name: Wewa RV Park and Trading Post
evidence: satellite 30.1463,-85.2129: Stone Mill Creek channel ~40-50 m W of the loop pads inside a continuous cypress-swamp fringe (~15-20 m of trees at the creek, leaf-on screen); no pad on open water or open apron to it

name: Wright Lake Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
evidence: rec.gov 251908 tags RV sites 15/17/18 'Lakefront' (prior claim of none was wrong), but their coords plot ~45 m (17,18) and ~90 m (15) from shore behind a ~15-20 m shoreline tree band (satellite 30.0004,-85.0004) -> tag too loose for on-water; open pine-savanna clearing toward lake + USFS 'views of the lake' -> lakeview

name: Little Talbot Island State Park
evidence: pin was the beach day-use lot; Reserve Florida grid (fac 112) GIS: RV sites 13-21 at lng -81.4207..-81.4210, W of A1A (highway between camp and ocean kills coastal woods); satellite 30.4572,-81.4212: pads ~40-110 m from Myrtle Creek marsh inside dense hammock; matches AWH note 'campground is not waterfront'

name: Karick Lake South Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
evidence: FFS ReserveAmerica: RV sites 1/3/5/7/9/11/13 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; GIS of 5, 7, 9 plot ~16-22 m from Karick Lake shore (satellite 30.8947,-86.6449) under open-understory pines, no ground screen; DEM 40 m at camp = lake, upstream of dam

name: Newport Park Campground
evidence: pin ~150 m E of the loop in woods; satellite 30.2000,-84.1765: loop ~65-70 m E of the St. Marks River behind dense hammock; Wakulla Co. campground map: river deck and boat ramp reached by walkways off the W loop, no riverside sites
